title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth | TechCrunch
summary: SpaceX doubled its revenue compared to last year, in large part thanks to the growth of its Starlink satellite internet service and deals it struck to rent out computing power to Anthropic and Google, the company revealed in its first quarterly earnings…
